testcase.name: Scenario: sketch-preferences-08 Apply Axes off reopen and restore: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/sketch/sketch-preferences/scenario.feature:28:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: sketch-preferences-08 Apply Axes off reopen and restore ✔ Given Axes is checked on Sketch preferences page ✔ When the user unchecks Axes and clicks Apply ✔ Then Apply becomes disabled and Close is displayed ✔ When the user closes Application Options ✔ Then the long sketch-axis line is absent while the global view triad remains ✔ When the user reopens Application Options ✔ Then Axes remains unchecked ✔ When the user checks Axes and applies and closes ✔ Then the long sketch-axis line returns
